objective: FOUR-CLAUSE-20261127-001's referee found that the four-clause step one layer up appears exactly on stages holding a chain of eight three-place knots, and that a bare chain of eight carries it. Test (a) whether a stage carries the step exactly when it holds such a chain, on held-out stages, and (b) how often ordinary growth builds such a chain, round by round to round 6, so whether growth makes the step typical under the census weighting.
status: Complete 2026-11-27 (referee pending): chains of eight on 82.5% of growing starts by round 6; 99.8% carry the step.
title: Does growth make the step one layer up typical? Chains of eight knots, round by round
